scope: Fresh HTTP download response ownership and existing-range validator recovery
change: Retain the first full response for a new download, verify parallel ranges only when useful, and keep recovery generations on the established validator path.

baseline.confirmedGap: A single-use range-aware URL consumed its only accepted GET on a disposable bytes=0-0 probe.

failures: Missing established ETag was not rejected

limitations: Live cases use controlled local HTTP fixtures, not public download sites.
The exact candidate was built and tested in an isolated directory, not installed or packaged.
Browser-owned response adoption remains separate work.
